name: gltfjsx
role: Convert glTF models to React Three Fiber
summary: Command-line tool that parses a glTF/GLB and emits a React Three Fiber component with each mesh, material and animation clip as addressable JSX, optionally TypeScript and with Draco/meshopt optimisation via gltf-transform. Run once at build time; output is source code. Distinguishing strength: scene graph becomes editable, typed JSX.
use_when: Over loading a raw GLB when you need to restyle or animate individual meshes in R3F
Generating typed R3F components for a model as a build step
Pruning and compressing a model while generating its component
avoid_when: Non-React Three.js: GLTFLoader directly, or three-js

install.macos: pnpm add -D gltfjsx@6.5.3 in an example directory (project-local, exact pin; not pnpm dlx)

evidence.result: partial: two gltfjsx 6.5.3 runs over one generated GLB are byte-identical (TSX 921 bytes, SHA-256 0f95f66ba2728d4a7472ff4831d17a2da21f334bb4399cc8aa27d8809f8da361). Body, Clasp, Wood and Metal are referenced; group CrateGroup is dropped under --types --keepnames, so run.sh exits 1. Strict typecheck and r3f render not run.
evidence.scope: Fixture-reported: gltfjsx 6.5.3 --types --keepnames on a generated GLB; reruns byte-identical; CrateGroup not referenced; no typecheck or render; macOS arm64.

assessment.rationale: Slow: last release Nov 2024 (about 23 months), no recent commits. Still the only CLI turning a .glb into typed react-three-fiber JSX; gltf-transform optimises but does not generate components. Recheck before relying on it.

notes: 2026-10-29: Skill opportunity: Further research first: verify a GLB-to-R3F fixture and current maintenance before proposing a standalone skill.

2026-11-24: --types output references GLTFAction in GLTFResult even for a GLB with no animations; strict tsc reports TS2304 for it. Also the output imports @react-three/drei and three-stdlib, which the fixture did not install. See examples/gltfjsx-r3f-component/README.md.
2026-11-24: Guide written at skills/gltfjsx/SKILL.md from partial evidence (generation, name references, rerun identity); typecheck, render, --transform untested.
